tasks.short: Monitor hydropower equipment and make necessary adjustments

steps.what: Monitor hydroelectric equipment operation and assess performance against specifications
Adjust equipment under authorised operating limits when performance requires intervention

tasks.design: Keep operating assessment and necessary adjustments with the technician using plant-control {OTHER}. Existing automatic controls and telemetry remain in place, with no new labour credit assigned to their runtime.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plant-specific operating conditions require judgement beyond a displayed limit.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated new coverage removes technician assessment or adjustment work.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising interacting conditions and the limits of instrumentation.
tasks.human_edge: Question an indication and choose the appropriate authorised intervention.

evidence.claim: Existing automatic control is not a new labour saving; technician operating judgement remains human in this scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is routine operating assessment and authorised adjustment, excluding fault investigation and record preparation allocated separately.
OTHER means plant-control and instrumentation software. No new structured safe-to-adjust flag or automatic command is introduced.
Native control configuration continues under its existing validation; no custom control software is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the workflow does not change.
unknowns: Installed control automation and required field checks
research_questions: Is any separately measured data-transfer burden present outside operating assessment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60+40=100, upkeep=0, net=0. Human operating assessment and adjustments remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify and address hydropower equipment malfunctions

steps.what: Identify malfunctions through equipment inspection and diagnostic evidence
Address diagnosed equipment malfunctions within the permitted maintenance scope

tasks.design: Retain fault inspection and authorised corrective work with the technician. Plant instrumentation {OTHER} and procedures in {DOCS} support diagnosis, while no automatic fault interpretation or physical repair is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Similar symptoms can have different physical causes.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated software change removes inspection or corrective work for this equipment.
tasks.still_hard: Determining the cause without extending a fault or exceeding authority.
tasks.human_edge: Compare hypotheses with the equipment's physical behaviour.

reach.learn: Equipment-specific fault limits and work authorisations

evidence.claim: Equipment fault inspection and physical corrective work remain human in this scenario.

assumptions: Boundary covers nonroutine fault investigation and permitted corrective work, excluding routine performance adjustment and formal work-record preparation allocated elsewhere.
OTHER means plant instrumentation and historian software. No machine diagnosis code or automatic maintenance authorisation is assumed.
Existing native alarms and trends continue with no new runtime-saving credit.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new tool or workflow is introduced.
unknowns: Equipment fault mix and diagnostic access
research_questions: Can a separate documentation search burden be reduced without claiming faster physical diagnosis?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60+40=100, upkeep=0, net=0. Physical diagnosis and corrective action retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Communicate equipment status to dispatchers or supervisors

steps.what: Communicate hydroelectric equipment status and confirm the recipient's understanding

tasks.design: Keep contextual equipment-status communication with the technician using {TELEPHONY}. Shared log access may support the exchange, but it does not replace explaining limitations and confirming that the dispatcher or supervisor understands them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Status can be technically correct yet operationally misleading without context.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated change removes the required acknowledgement conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining uncertainty and rapidly changing operating limitations.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a misunderstanding before it affects a dispatch decision.
tasks.altitude: The technician retains operating-status communication responsibility.

evidence.claim: Contextual status communication remains human; no task-level saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is status explanation and acknowledgement; collecting operating evidence and maintaining formal logs belong to their own tasks and are not duplicated.
No machine-produced availability classification or automatic dispatch message is introduced. Recipient time is unchanged and outside focal savings.
Existing native log viewing can continue without new configuration or runtime-saving credit.
Zero incremental upkeep because no communication workflow change is proposed.
unknowns: Required acknowledgement protocol and communication frequency
research_questions: Does shared log access reduce a distinct lookup burden while preserving status acknowledgement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, upkeep=0, net=0. The status exchange itself remains human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain hydroelectric work logs and reports

steps.what: Capture work performed and select the relevant operating evidence
Maintain logs and compile reports from work entries and operating readings
Check work records and release the completed log or report

tasks.design: Configure native log and report templates in the operational logbook {OTHER} before custom integration. The technician captures work facts once, linked historian fields fill repeated sections, and the technician checks the final record before release into {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Work entries and instrument evidence are copied into several record formats.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital operational logbooks can combine field entries and sensor data into standard records.
tasks.still_hard: Documenting the actual work and distinguishing observations from explanations.
tasks.human_edge: Know whether the record accurately represents the equipment and completed work.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate compilation, with retained accountability for log accuracy.

reach.learn: Evidence traceability and operational handover requirements

evidence.claim: Shiftconnector supports digital shift handover using sensor data and field notes; the proposed local labour saving still requires measurement.
The compilation share and upkeep allowance are unmeasured scenario assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining work records, excluding physical work, operating assessment and live status conversations assigned separately. A work request remains a draft record, not automatic maintenance authorisation.

Technician captures equipment identifier, event time and time zone, work category, factual narrative, performer, completion state and evidence references in s1's 40 hours. Historian instruments produce tag, timestamp, value, unit and quality before entry capture; technician validates selected tags. Missing readings or fields cause manual completion in s3 rather than fabricated values.
OTHER means operational logbook and historian software. Native templates and read-only tag links are tested first; existing automatic collection receives no new saving.
The scenario assumes repeated manual compilation exists today. If native reporting already removes it, the saving is zero.
unknowns: Existing digital logbook and reporting capabilities
Required record fields and sensor quality
research_questions: Does native report generation remove duplicate compilation after capture, checking and mapping upkeep?

already_counted.description: Check generated records and complete missing-data exceptions manually

incremental.description: Maintain report fields and check tag mappings after equipment changes
Maintain read-only historian access and interface health

approvals.approved_version: Exact log or report snapshot with work facts, timestamps, evidence references and completion state; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+0+25=65, gross=35, upkeep=6, net=29. Range 0-20 allows existing native reporting, incomplete readings and repeated corrections; interface-maintainer labour is outside focal savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Operating and maintenance judgement remain personal; duplicate log compilation is the principal proposed saving.
reach: Explain plant constraints in dispatch terminology
role.ambitious_version: A technician who gives equipment assessment full attention and maintains dependable records with less duplicate compilation.
